BiblicalUsage: Malkishua was a son of Saul, named in 1 Samuel 14:49 among Saul's sons, and in 1 Chronicles 8:33 in the genealogy of the house of Saul, while 1 Samuel 31:2 says the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul, on Gilboa. He fell with Jonathan and Abinadab on Gilboa, and his death is told in the same verse that ends Saul's house.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Malkishua's death on Gilboa is the end of Saul's house in one verse: three sons fallen, and the kingdom passing to David.
